body:
### UTC Date & Time

[July 23, 2026, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/jul-23-2026/2pm)

### Agenda

Devnet updates:

- Devnet 7 status & launch confirmation and status update
- SSZ in devnet-7, teku mentioned they saw slower performance. Has this been an issue or is it within acceptable degradation margins?
- Devnet 8 planning (what all blockers exist? is it just the bulider API changes or anything else?)


Glamsterdam:

- Beacon API PR #625 (ProduceBlock v4 auth/config) — urgent feedback requested July 9 from staking pools, builders, DVT providers, VC tooling (potuz/Nico/Terence). Has sufficient feedback been collected? PR ready to merge, or remaining concerns (KeyManager API support, DVT compatibility)? [[Add a POST produceBlockV4 by potuz · Pull Request #625 · ethereum/beacon-APIs · GitHub](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/625)](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/625 "https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/625")
- Other builder API/web3signer PRs to be discussed?
- BAL JSON-RPC alignment — Toni flagged across-EL-client divergence in BAL-specific JSON-RPC methods. EL teams to review discrepancies on [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1364000387195076608/1527979143881429153), target consistency before DevNet 8. Formal tests needed? [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1364000387195076608/1527979143881429153 "https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1364000387195076608/1527979143881429153")
- SFI ratification for DevNet 7 EIPs — Testing team (PandaOps) confirms all DevNet 7 EIPs OK for SFI. EL team agrees. Can ACDC officially ratify?

Hegota:

- sukunrt: EIP-8334 Bundled Attestation Propagation — 5 min discussion, requests PFI for Hegota. Backwards compatible change (no fork alignment needed). Deduplicates bandwidth used in attestation broadcast in subnets — up to 50% bandwidth savings. Implementation PR in Prysm (OffchainLabs/prysm#17210) + spec PR in consensus-specs#5464. [[Add EIP: Bundled Attestation Propagation by sukunrt · Pull Request #11905 · ethereum/EIPs · GitHub](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11905)](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11905 "https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11905")
- nerolation: EIP-8341 Partial Execution Payload Commitments — proposed as replacement/alternative for EIP-7862 (Delayed State Root). "Delay" EL state root on CL by not committing to it in the bid. Builder commits to everything in block header except state root. Should this be considered for Hegota? [[Add EIP: Partial Execution Payload Commitments by nerolation · Pull Request #11936 · ethereum/EIPs · GitHub](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11936)](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11936 "https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11936")
- kevaundray: EIP-8321 Hash-Chain RANDAO — proposed for Hegota. New RANDAO mechanism using hash-chain accumulators (with Benedikt as co-author). Discussion: could drand-like timelock encryption replace prevrandao? [[Add EIP: Hash-Chain RANDAO by kevaundray · Pull Request #11861 · ethereum/EIPs · GitHub](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11861)](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11861 "https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11861")
- etan-status: EIP-8015 PFI request — wants to PFI EIP-8015 for CL side of Hegota. What's the proposal, what's needed for inclusion? [EIP-8015: Remove `deposit` and `eth1data` fields](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8015 "https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8015")
- Non-headliner submission window closes August 6 (17 days away) — announced ACDE + ACDC #182. Follow same process as prior forks.
